planets.name: Kepler-1939 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-1939 with a 2.79-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: Kepler-1939 b was found in 2021 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-1939. Its orbit and size follow Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table's fit, the archive's default.
